about.title: About 3V
about.subtitle: A spiritual sanctuary, a luminous beacon guiding souls in a world searching for meaning
about.missionP1: Founded on January 1, 2024, the Way, Truth, Life (3V) association is much more than a simple organization: it is a spiritual sanctuary, a luminous beacon guiding young people in a world searching for meaning.
about.missionP2: Rooted in the timeless principles of the Christian faith, 3V stands as a bulwark against the storms of moral decay, with particular emphasis on the spiritual and moral well-being of youth.
about.missionP3: Our approach combines biblical wisdom with modern activities, meaningful discussions and spiritual resources to help everyone find their path to a more fulfilling life centered on eternal values.
about.mainVerse: "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me."
about.obj1: Offer a spiritual and moral refuge to young people facing the challenges of modern society
about.obj2: Educate and raise awareness about the Christian faith and its principles
about.obj3: Create a caring community of mutual help and spiritual support
about.obj4: Promote a healthy and balanced lifestyle based on Gospel values
about.obj5: Train Christian leaders as agents of transformation in their communities
about.obj6: Establish partnerships with religious and community organizations
about.offerReadingsDesc: A structured 354-day program for progressive immersion in the Holy Scriptures.
about.offerLentDesc: A period of reflection, meditation and prayer to deepen your faith.
about.offerStationsDesc: A meditation on Christ's sacrifice and the path of salvation.
about.offerCommunityDesc: Meetings, workshops and events to grow together spiritually.
about.offerPrayerDesc: A space for sharing prayer intentions and mutual support.
about.offerResourcesDesc: Galleries, guides and materials to deepen your understanding of faith.
about.timeline2024aDesc: Official creation of the Way, Truth, Life association on January 1, 2024, a spiritual sanctuary dedicated to Catholic youth.
about.timeline2024bDesc: Launch of conferences, spiritual formation workshops and community activities for young people.
about.timeline2024cDesc: Design and development of the 3V web application to make spiritual content accessible to everyone.
about.timeline2025a: Launch of the biblical reading program
about.timeline2025aDesc: Structured 358-day program covering all 73 books of the Catholic Bible, from November 30, 2025 to November 22, 2026.
about.timeline2025bDesc: Implementation of the Lenten journey with 40 days of prayer, penance and sharing to accompany the faithful towards Easter.
about.timeline2025c: Stations of the Cross and Novenas
about.timeline2025cDesc: Addition of the 14 Stations of the Cross and day-by-day guided novenas to deepen prayer life.
about.timeline2026aDesc: A space for sharing prayer intentions and mutual support among community members.
about.timeline2026bDesc: Integration of an intelligent assistant to accompany the faithful in their spiritual and biblical questions.

prayers.prayer1: Lord, bless {{name}} this day. Grant them your peace, light their path and fill their heart with joy. Amen.
prayers.prayer2: Heavenly Father, watch over {{name}}. Give them the strength to face this day and the wisdom to follow your will. Amen.
prayers.prayer3: Holy Spirit, accompany {{name}} at every moment. May your light dispel their doubts and your love strengthen them. Amen.
prayers.prayer4: Lord Jesus, take {{name}} by the hand today. May every step be guided by your grace and every word inspired by your Spirit. Amen.
prayers.prayer5: God of love, surround {{name}} with your protection. May this day be filled with blessings and moments of grace. Amen.
prayers.prayer6: Mary, Mother of God, intercede for {{name}}. Cover them with your maternal mantle and lead them to your Son. Amen.
prayers.prayer7: Lord, may {{name}} feel your presence today. Strengthen their faith, revive their hope and set their heart ablaze with love. Amen.

documents3v.title: 3V Documents
documents3v.subtitle: Find all the official documents of the Voie-Vérité-Vie Movement here — founding documents, regulations and forms.
documents3v.footer: These documents form the official canonical corpus of the Voie-Vérité-Vie Movement. Founder-Moderator: AHOUFACK DYLANNE BAUDOUIN — Douala, Cameroon.

statuts.title: 3V Statutes
statuts.description: The canonical reference document of the association — 15 Titles, 136 Articles. Defines the legal nature, identity, governance and foundations of the Movement.

reglementInterieur.title: Internal Regulations
reglementInterieur.description: Specifies the practical operation of 3V in application of the Statutes — 14 Titles, 85 Articles. Governs membership, bodies, activities and financial life.

regleDeVie.title: Rule of Life
regleDeVie.description: The inner face of 3V — 10 Chapters, 55 Articles. Concretely translates the pillars of spiritual life for each member: prayer, penance, formation and service.

texteCharisme.title: Text of the Charism
texteCharisme.description: Founding document n°5 expounding the nature, sources and expressions of 3V's charism — 7 Chapters. A gift of the Holy Spirit for the edification of the Body of Christ.

acteFondation.title: Act of Foundation
acteFondation.description: Founding document n°3 — official act of creation of the Movement on January 1, 2024 in Douala, feast of Mary Mother of God. 5 Parts, 22 Articles.

reglementNumerique.title: Digital Internal Regulations
reglementNumerique.description: Governs 3V's digital presence: official platforms, editorial policy, member conduct online and data protection — 6 Titles, 39 Articles.

formulairesAdhesion.title: Membership Application Dossier
